items.q: What is the difference between ROW_NUMBER, RANK and DENSE_RANK?
items.a:
ROW_NUMBER gives 1,2,3 even for ties; RANK gives ties the same number and leaves gaps (1,1,3);
DENSE_RANK gives ties the same number without gaps (1,1,2).

items.q: What is the difference between WHERE and HAVING?
items.a: WHERE filters rows before grouping; HAVING filters groups after GROUP BY, so it can use aggregates.

items.q: Find the second highest salary from the employees table.
items.a:
```
SELECT MAX(salary) AS second_highest
FROM employees
WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees);
```

items.q: Find the second lowest salary from the employees table.
items.a:
```
SELECT MIN(salary) AS second_lowest
FROM employees
WHERE salary > (SELECT MIN(salary) FROM employees);
```
